## At which university, laboratory or company, and in which years, was Environment-Based Design developed, and who led that work?

### Takeaway
EBD is associated throughout the retrieved literature with one person, Yong Zeng, and with Concordia University in Montréal (Concordia Institute for Information Systems Engineering, "Design Lab"), where he has been a professor since 2003; the work's stated lineage runs from a 1991 paper co-authored with G. Cheng in *Design Studies*, through papers with P. Gu in the late 1990s, to the formal EBD statements of 2001–2015. Zeng's doctoral and postdoctoral base before Concordia was the University of Calgary (PhD 2001), and earlier academic posts in China.

### Cited Findings
- Yong Zeng is "Professor/Associate Director and Co-Op Director, Concordia Institute for Information Systems Engineering"; he holds "Ph.D. (2001) Design Engineering, University of Calgary, Canada" and "Ph.D. (1992) Computational Mechanics, Dalian University of Technology, China"; "He has proposed a new design theory called Environment-Based Design (EBD)"; he was Canada Research Chair (Tier II) in design science (2004–2014), NSERC Chair in Aerospace Design Engineering (2015–2019), and President of the Society for Design and Process Science 2019–2023 — [ebdgo.org, Team members](https://ebdgo.org/team-members/)
